about: Carolyn L. Kirkland is an attorney who represents clients in the Miami, Florida area. Carolyn Kirkland is recognized by peers and was selected to Rising Stars for 2021, 2023 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Carolyn Kirkland chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. She attended University of Miami School of Law and graduated in 2015. Carolyn Kirkland passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2015.
She represents clients with Estate & Trust Litigation issues in Florida. She also represents clients with Estate Planning & Probate issues.

Being selected to Rising Stars is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Rising Stars, Carolyn Kirkland has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
